description: Seed configuration for the next deterministic advanced indicator layer. These indicators improve business-fit reasoning and transparency without introducing legal compliance or zoning-validity claims.

indicators.name: proxy_confidence_score
indicators.purpose: Express how grounded the tract/business analysis is, given the mix of direct indicators, constructed proxies, and missing advanced indicators.
indicators.business_value: Helps the user understand whether the current fit result is strongly data-grounded or still heavily heuristic.

formula_v1.description: Weighted blend of direct-data ratio, indicator coverage ratio, and business-model clarity.

limitations: Some proxies may still be analytically strong.
This score is a transparency aid, not a scientific certainty score.
recommended_ui_role: fit summary label such as 'Analytical Confidence'

indicators.name: data_completeness_score
indicators.purpose: Express whether the system currently has enough relevant indicators to answer the business-fit question well.
indicators.business_value: Helps the system state when the result is partial and when additional data or a future discovery agent would be useful.

formula_v1.description: Weighted coverage of active business needs based on how well each need is currently supported by the tract model.

subcomponents.total_active_need_weight: sum of active interpreted location_needs values
subcomponents.covered_need_weight: for each active need, need_weight multiplied by support_level (1.0, 0.6, or 0.3)

limitations: Support levels are deterministic policy values, not discovered truths.
Not all missing indicators are equally important.
This score should signal completeness, not authority.
recommended_ui_role: fit summary label such as 'Data Coverage'

indicators.name: after_work_leisure_proxy
indicators.purpose: Estimate whether the tract is suitable for after-work leisure, hobby, class-based activity, and the transition from work into leisure.
indicators.business_value: Improves reasoning for ceramic studios, yoga, language classes, creative workshops, casual wine bars, and social clubs.

formula_v1.description: Weighted blend of evening/social vitality, access, active commercial context, and destination convenience.

limitations: This is still a transitional indicator until office_worker_presence exists.
It may over-reward active evening areas for some class-based uses.
It should be presented as a proxy, not a direct measure of leisure demand.
recommended_ui_role: later transparency panel label such as 'After-work leisure potential'
